name: Issue 5699: Weapon Engraving: Ice procs its Frost damage from direct damage
contract: Weapon Engraving: Ice 653264 puts temporary enchant 1004 (type 3, equip spell 653266) on the weapon. Ice Engraving
653266 reads 'Your direct damage has a $h% chance to deal ... Frost damage': aura 42 triggering 653217, ProcChance
40, DBC ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs never gave it a proc entry and the aura
never procs. Fire 653211 and Earth 653221 proc through spell_proc (0x00010154, DAMAGE, HIT). 653266 is applied
as a fixture aura (the scenario format has no item target for cast). Expected: with Master Engraver 705605
(40 -> 45%) landed auto attacks proc 653266 and deal 653217 Frost damage to the target (about 20 swings over
27 sec, so no proc has probability 0.55^20 < 7e-6); removing 653266 stops further 653217 damage.

steps.label: A fast dagger lands many swings
Ice Engraving, the equip spell of the Weapon Engraving: Ice enchant
SETUP: Master Engraver raises the proc chance to 45%
CONTRACT: direct damage procs Ice Engraving
CONTRACT: the proc deals Weapon Engraving: Ice Frost damage to the target
CONTRACT: no Weapon Engraving: Ice damage without the engraving
